what_it_establishes: [Observed] a refused click is a safe trigger of the sweep: it posts nothing to the ledger and recovers up to SWEEP_MAX (3) abandoned claims older than STALE_MIN (10) minutes whose lock is free, each audited (auth_sweep + auth_recovered_undone or auth_posted)
[Observed] the sweep ran before the voucher's own refusal (audit order 9940, 9941, then 9942; 171 ms for the recovery inside a 433 ms request)

[Deduced] on live this is the way to clear an abandoned claim during the payment freeze without making a new posting: after ten minutes, Accounts clicks Authorise once on any already-authorised voucher (section 5, step 6 of the proposal)
